Comparative dimensions abstain: not assessed by the source evaluation. comparison.mode is "abstain" and outcome is ABSTAIN where no language dimension failed: the evaluation this record transcribes assessed only the seven absolute language_quality dimensions and made no comparative judgement against a reference on any of the five comparative axes. Recording mode "pairwise" would assert a comparison that never happened, and a comparative PASS would claim the draft was measured against the reference and held up. The references are still named because they were the genre-matched pool available and a later comparative pass should use them.
